Job Title: CQV Lead Utilities Location: Netherlands Contract Type: Staff or Contract (12-month project) Job Summary We are seeking a CQV Lead – Utilities (Team Lead) to lead a team of engineers and specialists in the Commissioning, Qualification, and Validation (CQV) of critical utility systems within a GMP pharmaceutical environment. This role will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing CQV activities across clean and black utilities, ensuring successful delivery on time, on budget, and fully compliant with regulatory standards. Key Responsibilities •Lead and manage a team of CQV engineers, contractors, and specialists in all commissioning and qualification activities. •Oversee CQV activities for clean and black utility systems (Purified Water (PW), WFI (Water for Injection), Clean Steam, Process Gases, HVAC systems, Cooling Towers). •Act as the CQV Subject Matter Expert (SME) for utilities throughout the project lifecycle. •Develop, execute, and approve commissioning and qualification documentation, including IQ/OQ (PQ where applicable). •Lead and support commissioning activities, ensuring systems are installed, tested, and operate as designed. •Review and approve URS, design specifications, risk assessments, and CQV deliverables. •Ensure compliance with EU GMP, FDA, ISPE Baseline Guides, and internal quality standards. •Coordinate CQV activities with Engineering, Quality, Automation, and Operations teams. •Monitor progress, resource allocation, and quality of CQV deliverables, ensuring timelines are met. •Support deviations, change controls, and impact assessments related to utilities. •Represent the utilities team during regulatory inspections and audits. Key Requirements •Experience in pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical environments with team leadership responsibility. •Strong hands-on experience in Commissioning of utility systems (key requirement). •Proven CQV experience with clean and black utilities, including PW, WFI, clean steam, HVAC, process gases, and cooling towers. •Experience using Kneat (e-validation system) — training will be provided if required. •Knowledge of GMP, ISPE Baseline Guides, and regulatory compliance requirements. •Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. •Ability to prioritize and manage multiple activities in a fast-paced project environment. improbable-improbable:ashbyhq:87dbae77-a.title: Head of Marketing
improbable-improbable:ashbyhq:87dbae77-a.description: At Improbable, we build and scale ambitious AI and Web3 ventures shaping the next generation of the internet. We’re hiring for a venture building a next-generation blockchain for real-time, large-scale applications. Designed to overcome the speed and cost limitations of traditional blockchain infrastructure, the technology is fast, cost-efficient and fully EVM-compatible, enabling developers, creators and communities to build immersive products with greater ownership and interoperability. The ecosystem includes a first-party DEX, a prediction markets protocol and several upcoming products. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Head of Marketing to turn this technology and product portfolio into adoption, volume and a recognised market position. This is the venture’s most senior marketing role. You will report to the CEO, join the leadership team and own marketing across the Layer 1 and the products built on it. You will build a product-led marketing engine that can repeatedly take technical products to market, acquire users and turn launches into sustained growth. This is a player-coach role. You will set the strategy, build and lead the team, and remain close enough to the work to sharpen positioning, challenge campaigns and lead important launches yourself. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING - Own the marketing and growth strategy: Set the priorities, targets and operating model across the Layer 1, first-party DEX, prediction markets protocol and future products. - Drive product adoption: Build measurable acquisition, activation and retention programmes for traders, developers, partners and the wider Web3 market. - Lead positioning and launches: Define the venture’s narrative and create clear positioning and go-to-market plans for each product. - Build a high-performing function: Shape the team, establish clear accountability and keep internal and external specialists focused on product and commercial outcomes. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR You are a product and growth-focused marketing leader who has worked successfully across both Web2 financial products and Web3. You understand the structured, data-led approach to marketing found in fintech or traditional finance. You have also applied that experience within a Web3 environment such as a DeFi, DEX, Layer 1 or Layer 2. - Senior marketing leadership experience across both Web2 and Web3 - End-to-end ownership of positioning, go-to-market and growth - Evidence of increasing users, trading volume, revenue or market share - A strong understanding of acquisition, activation and retention - Experience leading teams while remaining hands-on - The ability to use data to prioritise decisions and measure results If you have built and scaled marketing across both Web2 financial products and Web3, and want to shape how a next-generation blockchain ecosystem goes to market, we’d like to hear from you.
